the effect of financial center on firm performance.
the role of the location of a firm on its performance.
the impact of location on firm’s performance.

, in an emerging market, the location of a firm has an impact on its performance.
firms headquartered in financial center outperformed firms headquartered in other places because of their better information environment.
firms headquartered in financial centers outperform firms headquartered in non-financial centers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
firms headquartered in Mumbai outperform other firms in the market.
the location of a firm has a significant effect on the firm’s performance.
firms headquartered in a financial center have better portfolio performance than their counterparts.
The main takeaway from our work is that

firms headquartered in Mumbai outperform firms headquartered in other parts of the country, and that clustering of firms in a financial center improves information environment of firms, and thereby improves their performance.

, for a given level of resources available to the market participants, it is relatively easier and cost effective for them to expend their resources to obtain value relevant firm-specific information on firms clustered in the financial center than on dispersed firms in the market.
investors can benefit from clustering effect by investing in firms headquartered in the main financial centers of a country.
